tagline: Save a bag, save the baraka.

language.title: Language
language.rtlNotice: Switching to Arabic restarts the app to enable right-to-left layout.

errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

hero.subtitle: Shops near you sell their unsold food of the day as low-price Surprise Bags. Good for you, good for the planet.

step1.title: Discover
step1.text: Browse the shops around you and spot today’s Surprise Bags.

step2.title: Reserve
step2.text: Book your bag in seconds, before everyone else grabs theirs.

step3.title: Pick up
step3.text: Drop by the shop during the pickup window and leave with your happy surprise.

bag.title: What’s a Surprise Bag?
bag.text: An assortment of the day’s unsold food — breads, pastries, prepared meals, fruit and veg — sold at a small price. The exact contents stay a surprise: that’s the fun, and that’s what saves the food.

merchant.title: Run a food business?
merchant.text: Turn your surplus into revenue, reach new customers and cut your waste. Signing up is free.

app.title: Baraka, soon in your pocket
app.text: Reserve, track your orders and get notified when your bag is ready — straight from the mobile app.

browse.title: Surprise bags near you
browse.subtitle: Reserve a bag of unsold food and pick it up today.
browse.empty: No bags for this search. Try another category.

favorites.emptySubtitle: Add your favourite shops to find them here.

hero.title: Turn your surplus food into revenue
hero.text: Every evening, meals, bread and produce go to waste. Sell them as discounted Surprise Bags: recover value, win new customers and cut your waste.

revenue.title: Extra revenue
revenue.text: Today's unsold items become turnover instead of ending up in the bin.

customers.title: New customers
customers.text: Neighbours discover your store by reserving a bag — and come back.

zeroRisk.title: Zero risk
zeroRisk.text: Free sign-up, no fixed fees, no commitment: a commission only on online sales.

impact.title: Real impact
impact.text: Every bag saved avoids about 2.5 kg of CO₂e — your customers see it, and so does your brand.

step1.title: Create your bags
step1.text: Describe your Surprise Bags (price, typical contents) and set the weekly schedule: they go on sale automatically.

step2.title: Customers reserve
step2.text: Track reservations in real time from your dashboard, on desktop or phone.

step3.title: Validate the pickup
step3.text: At the counter, the customer shows a 6-digit code. Type it in and it's done — online sales are paid out by bank transfer.

control.label: control: quantities, prices and time slots, adjustable daily

cta.title: Ready to save your surplus?
cta.text: Create your account and send your application in two minutes — our team reviews it quickly.
